summary: Carlyle Private Equity Partners Fund, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of equity securities under Items 3.02 and 8.01. On June 1, 2026, the Fund sold limited partnership units for aggregate consideration of approximately $16.4 million, with prices set at the Transactional NAV per unit as of May 31, 2026. The sale was part of a continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. No special-situation event is described; this is a routine capital raise by a closed-end fund. There is no deal, contest, or restructuring to analyze; the filing merely discloses a standard periodic securities issuance.
